changelog:
- Fixed false Everything Up to Date on clients left running while the host receives new commits.
- SmartSync now fetches and verifies host state before choosing Pull, Push, or Up to Date.
- Expired or failed host checks remain unverified; local refresh cannot turn a failed fetch green.
- Fetch uses a 120-second inactivity timeout with progress and cancellation, allowing active transfers longer than six seconds.
- Fixed misleading sync completion and workflow status after failed host checks.
